selection.name: C01 — Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (Canonical WSL image)
selection.role: Provisional preferred base distribution; complete target-host acceptance remains unresolved.
selection.install_source: Canonical vendor image: https://releases.ubuntu.com/26.04.1/ubuntu-26.04.1-wsl-amd64.wsl . Run the installation command in Windows PowerShell after verifying SHA-256.

basis.shows: Registers the exact Canonical AMD64 image and SHA-256 48d56724b5c8e60f24893e83e73bbb58c60b3ca22fba3da977075420acd54104. All five candidates have modern AMD64 image URLs and checksum fields; checksum availability alone does not separate them.
Documents Ubuntu 26.04, direct vendor-image installation and the --from-file command. The new image format requires WSL 2.4.10 or newer, below the packet's stated 2.7.13.
Documents automatic SHA-256 verification through wsl --install and manual verification of downloaded images with Get-FileHash.

Supports Ubuntu 26.04 on WSL and states five years of standard support for numbered LTS releases. Its later support horizon than 24.04 is an inference from their release years; selection does not depend on paid extensions.
Default-branch commit dated 2026-08-28, inside the 90-day window beginning 2026-07-03. Repository metadata reports not archived.
Recent issue activity: the request to update the Ubuntu Store application to 26.04 closed on 2026-08-29.
Successful upstream Windows build CI on 2026-08-27. This verifies build activity, not functional acceptance of either exact candidate image.
Upstream tests cover default users, systemd state, failed units and interoperability. They do not establish successful systemd user-service operation on the target host.

Documents CUDA for Ubuntu 24.04 or newer on WSL2, explicitly demonstrates installation on Ubuntu 26.04 AMD64, and publishes a deviceQuery PASS example. The example uses another GPU, so it establishes neither RTX 4090 performance nor comparative superiority.

not_selected.name: Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS (Canonical WSL image)
not_selected.reason: Closest alternative: exact image/checksum and the same maintained Ubuntu WSL source are verified, but 26.04 offers a later standard-support horizon; no target-host result separates their practical reliability. [Support policy](https://github.com/canonical/ubuntu-pro-for-wsl/blob/main/docs/reference/distributions.md)

not_selected.name: Debian 13 (WSL distribution)
not_selected.reason: Five-year support, Python 3.13 and systemd 257 are documented, but the required WSL toolchain, user-service and RTX 4090 acceptance evidence remains unresolved. [Debian release announcement](https://www.debian.org/News/2025/20250809)

not_selected.name: Arch Linux (WSL distribution)
not_selected.reason: Vendor AMD64 image/checksum are verified; long-term-support fit and distribution-specific maintenance/test evidence were insufficiently verified to prefer it. [Registry](https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/blob/c34e75aea8dcc50c0c2f9e76b2de9b26a58e8b67/distributions/DistributionInfo.json)

not_selected.name: Fedora (WSL distribution)
not_selected.reason: Vendor Fedora 44 AMD64 image/checksum are verified; long-term-support fit and distribution-specific maintenance/test evidence were insufficiently verified to prefer it. [Registry](https://github.com/microsoft/WSL/blob/c34e75aea8dcc50c0c2f9e76b2de9b26a58e8b67/distributions/DistributionInfo.json)

layers.deciding_comparison: Compare Ubuntu 26.04.1, Ubuntu 24.04.5 and Debian 13 on the stated WSL 2.7.13/kernel 6.18/RTX 4090 host. Verify vendor-image hashes, run the same bootstrap, and measure first-boot success/time, repeated startup, systemd --user service activation, Python 3.13/Node 24/current Rust builds, CUDA deviceQuery and an identical GPU workload, plus Claude Code/Codex shell smoke tests. No recorded all-arm comparison or verified public benchmark establishes a measured winner.
evidence_gaps: The required ctx_fetch_and_index calls were blocked because approval was required and session policy is never. Five requested page fetches produced no content for ctx_search; findings instead use GitHub API source files and official search results. The mandated page-retrieval workflow remains incomplete.
Budget used: six web-search queries and 30 GitHub API calls, including one 404.
Exact Python 3.13, Node 24, current Rust, systemd user services and RTX 4090 behavior were not verified on any candidate image. No agent-client compatibility advantage is established.
The Ubuntu e2e workflow API returned zero main-branch runs. Successful build/example CI cannot substitute for exact-image functional test results.

Ubuntu's latest GitHub launcher release is dated 2022-08-11; it is distinct from current vendor WSL image releases. Official search results show recent image publication, but release-directory pages could not be fetched.

Microsoft/WSL is a shared runtime and registry. Its recent commits do not establish Debian, Arch or Fedora maintenance health; their build repositories' default-branch dates, issue activity and CI remain unverified.
ARM64 registry images target Windows ARM64 WSL. Documented WSL installation requires Windows; native macOS arm64 support was not established.
Published checksums were inspected; image bytes and signed manifests were not downloaded or validated. No closed exclusion criterion was established for an unselected candidate.
